name: species
title: Taxa represented in the linkage-map database
description: One row per distinct species string in the source data. Names resolved against the Open Tree of Life taxonomy (TNRS + taxon_info), with lineages extracted and NCBI Taxonomy used as an independent cross-check. Source taxonomy columns are retained alongside the resolved values so every change is auditable.

fields.name: ott_id
fields.description: Open Tree of Life taxon id, "ott" + integer. PRIMARY KEY. Not unique where two source names are synonyms of one taxon — see flag_duplicate_taxon.

fields.name: species_name
fields.description: Species name as used in this database (source string with underscores replaced). Unique.

fields.name: ott_accepted_name
fields.description: Currently accepted name in the OTT taxonomy. Differs from species_name where the source used a synonym.

fields.name: ott_unique_name
fields.description: OTT disambiguated name (includes homonym qualifiers).

fields.name: taxon_rank
fields.description: Rank of the matched taxon. Should be "species"; see flag_not_species_rank.

fields.name: kingdom
fields.description: From the OTT lineage. Absent for protists/algae where OTT has no kingdom-rank ancestor — use eukaryote_supergroup.

fields.name: phylum
fields.description: From the OTT lineage.

fields.name: class
fields.description: From the OTT lineage.

fields.name: order
fields.description: From the OTT lineage.

fields.name: family
fields.description: From the OTT lineage.

fields.name: genus
fields.description: From the OTT lineage.

fields.name: major_clades
fields.description: First six unranked clades in the OTT lineage (e.g. fabids; rosids; eudicotyledons).

fields.name: full_lineage
fields.description: Complete OTT lineage, root-ward, semicolon-separated.

fields.name: ncbi_taxid
fields.description: NCBI Taxonomy id from OTT tax_sources.

fields.name: gbif_id
fields.description: GBIF taxon key from OTT tax_sources.

fields.name: irmng_id
fields.description: IRMNG id from OTT tax_sources.

fields.name: ncbi_name
fields.description: Scientific name in NCBI Taxonomy, retrieved independently as a cross-check.

fields.name: ncbi_family
fields.description: Family per NCBI Taxonomy.

fields.name: ncbi_order
fields.description: Order per NCBI Taxonomy.

fields.name: ncbi_class
fields.description: Class per NCBI Taxonomy.

fields.name: ncbi_confirms_family
fields.description: TRUE where NCBI and OTT agree on family. 97% agreement.

fields.name: chromosome_number_1n
fields.description: Haploid chromosome number from the source data. Null where map records for the species disagree.

fields.name: chromosome_number_2n
fields.description: Diploid chromosome number from the source data. Null where records disagree.

fields.name: flag_chromosome_conflict
fields.description: TRUE where map records for this species report different chromosome numbers.

fields.name: n_map_records
fields.description: Number of rows in the source working file for this species.

fields.name: source_species_string
fields.description: Verbatim species string in LinkageMapIinfo2.csv. Provenance anchor.

fields.name: source_ott_id
fields.description: OTT id stored in the source file (numeric).

fields.name: source_supergroup
fields.description: Tax.grp in the source file.

fields.name: source_group
fields.description: Group in the source file.

fields.name: source_class
fields.description: Class in the source file.

fields.name: source_order
fields.description: Order in the source file.

fields.name: source_family
fields.description: Family in the source file.

fields.name: ott_match_score
fields.description: TNRS match score, 0-1. 1.0 is exact.

fields.name: flag_ott_id_changed
fields.description: TRUE where the stored OTT id does not equal the id the name now resolves to. 42 records.

fields.name: ott_change_type
fields.description: Why the id changed: stored_was_hybrid, stored_was_infraspecific, same_genus_diff_species, different_taxon, stored_id_dead.

fields.name: ott_change_note
fields.description: Human-readable explanation of the change.

fields.name: flag_name_is_synonym
fields.description: TRUE where the source name is a synonym of the accepted name. 32 records.

fields.name: flag_fuzzy_match
fields.description: TRUE where the name matched only approximately (likely a misspelling). 6 records.

fields.name: flag_not_species_rank
fields.description: TRUE where the match is a genus or subspecies rather than a species. 8 records.

fields.name: flag_unresolved
fields.description: TRUE where no OTT match could be found. 0 records.

fields.name: flag_source_family_differs
fields.description: TRUE where the family in the source file differs from OTT. 37 records.

fields.name: source_family_issue
fields.description: Whether the family difference looks like a spelling error in the source or a genuine taxonomic revision.

fields.name: flag_duplicate_taxon
fields.description: TRUE where another row resolves to the same OTT taxon (synonym pairs entered twice).

fields.name: duplicate_taxon_note
fields.description: Which rows share this taxon and what to do about it.

fields.name: eukaryote_supergroup
fields.description: Major eukaryote group (Chloroplastida, Metazoa, Fungi, SAR, Rhodophyta, Discoba). Populated for every row; the field to group by for cross-eukaryote analyses.
